nodes.long_description:
1. Cut the bottom of a pet flat 
2. Put the cut plastic bottle under the other plastic bottle and put the warhead on the top 
3. Cut the milk carton and make 3 wings 
4. Add water to the completed water rocket 
5.Put it on the launch pad and pump it 
6. Press the trigger switch from a distance away
nodes.short_description: Building and launching a water rocket in virtual reality can help you understand various scientific principles such as pressure, motion, and air resistance.
